description: This file defines utility functions for creating and manipulating enum-like string schemas using the '@sinclair/typebox' library. It provides functions to create string enums, optional string enums, and schemas for 'channel target' strings and arrays thereof, incorporating external descriptive constants.

methods.name: export function stringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( stringEnum
methods.description: Creates a string enum schema using Type.Unsafe, with validation that enum values are strings, optionally with description, title, and default.

methods.name: export function optionalStringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( optionalStringEnum
methods.description: Wraps stringEnum to make the enum optional in schema.

methods.name: export function channelTargetSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetSchema
methods.description: Creates a schema for a single channel target string, with optional description.

methods.name: export function channelTargetsSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetsSchema
methods.description: Creates a schema for an array of channel target strings, with optional description.
